name: 7zip
info: 7-Zip is a free, open-source file archiver supporting numerous compression formats. It offers high compression ratios, strong encryption, and file-management tools for users across Windows and other supported platforms.

name: affine
info: AFFiNE is an open-source workspace combining documents, whiteboards, and knowledge management. It helps individuals and teams organize ideas, collaborate visually, and manage projects across modern digital workflows.

name: aliexpress
info: AliExpress is a global online marketplace connecting consumers with merchants worldwide. It offers products across electronics, fashion, home goods, and many other categories, supporting cross-border e-commerce.

name: amazon-prime
info: Amazon Prime is a subscription service offering eligible members shipping benefits, streaming entertainment, exclusive deals, and additional digital services across Amazon's international retail ecosystem.

name: anaconda
info: Anaconda provides tools and services for Python and data science, including package management, environments, and enterprise AI infrastructure used by developers, researchers, and organizations worldwide.

name: ansible
info: Ansible is an open-source automation platform used to configure systems, deploy applications, and orchestrate IT infrastructure through readable playbooks and agentless remote management.
